id,corp_id AS corpId,room_id AS roomId,wecom_userid AS wecomUserid,participant_type AS participantType,staff_user_id AS staffUserId,external_userid AS externalUserid,status,confirmed_at AS confirmedAt,removed_at AS removedAt,version

SELECT 1 FROM crm_wecom_room_participant covered JOIN crm_wecom_staff_account sa ON sa.tenant_id=covered.tenant_id AND sa.corp_id=covered.corp_id AND sa.wecom_userid=covered.wecom_userid AND sa.staff_user_id=covered.staff_user_id AND sa.enabled=1 JOIN crm_wecom_archive_member am ON am.tenant_id=covered.tenant_id AND am.corp_id=covered.corp_id AND am.staff_user_id=covered.staff_user_id AND am.enabled=1 JOIN sys_user su ON su.tenant_id=covered.tenant_id AND su.id=covered.staff_user_id AND su.status='ACTIVE' WHERE covered.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND covered.corp_id=#{corpId} AND covered.room_id=#{roomId} AND covered.status='ACTIVE' AND covered.participant_type='STAFF'

SELECT FROM crm_wecom_room WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND corp_id=#{corpId} AND room_id=#{roomId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM crm_wecom_room r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.corp_id=#{corpId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_wecom_room_participant rp JOIN crm_wecom_staff_account sa ON sa.tenant_id=rp.tenant_id AND sa.corp_id=rp.corp_id AND sa.wecom_userid=rp.wecom_userid AND sa.staff_user_id=rp.staff_user_id AND sa.enabled=1 JOIN crm_wecom_archive_member am ON am.tenant_id=rp.tenant_id AND am.corp_id=rp.corp_id AND am.staff_user_id=rp.staff_user_id AND am.enabled=1 JOIN sys_user su ON su.tenant_id=rp.tenant_id AND su.id=rp.staff_user_id AND su.status='ACTIVE' WHERE rp.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND rp.corp_id=r.corp_id AND rp.room_id=r.room_id AND rp.participant_type='STAFF' AND rp.status='ACTIVE'
AND (su.id=#{selfId} OR su.team_id IN #{teamId}) AND su.id=#{selfId} )
AND 1=0
ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 200

mapper.update: UPDATE crm_wecom_room SET display_name=#{room.displayName},status=#{room.status},source_evidence_ref=#{room.sourceEvidenceRef},membership_confirmed_at=#{now},created_by=#{actorUserId},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND corp_id=#{room.corpId} AND room_id=#{room.roomId} AND version=#{room.version}

UPDATE crm_wecom_room_participant SET participant_type=#{participant.participantType},staff_user_id=#{participant.staffUserId},external_userid=#{participant.externalUserid},status=#{participant.status},confirmed_at=#{now},removed_at=#{participant.removedAt},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND corp_id=#{participant.corpId} AND room_id=#{participant.roomId} AND wecom_userid=#{participant.wecomUserid} AND version=#{participant.version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT covered.staff_user_id) FROM crm_wecom_room_participant covered JOIN crm_wecom_staff_account sa ON sa.tenant_id=covered.tenant_id AND sa.corp_id=covered.corp_id AND sa.wecom_userid=covered.wecom_userid AND sa.staff_user_id=covered.staff_user_id AND sa.enabled=1 JOIN crm_wecom_archive_member am ON am.tenant_id=covered.tenant_id AND am.corp_id=covered.corp_id AND am.staff_user_id=covered.staff_user_id AND am.enabled=1 JOIN sys_user su ON su.tenant_id=covered.tenant_id AND su.id=covered.staff_user_id AND su.status='ACTIVE' WHERE covered.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND covered.corp_id=#{corpId} AND covered.room_id=#{roomId} AND covered.status='ACTIVE' AND covered.participant_type='STAFF'

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_wecom_room_participant sender JOIN crm_wecom_staff_account sa ON sa.tenant_id=sender.tenant_id AND sa.corp_id=sender.corp_id AND sa.wecom_userid=sender.wecom_userid AND sa.staff_user_id=sender.staff_user_id AND sa.enabled=1 JOIN crm_wecom_archive_member am ON am.tenant_id=sender.tenant_id AND am.corp_id=sender.corp_id AND am.staff_user_id=sender.staff_user_id AND am.enabled=1 JOIN sys_user su ON su.tenant_id=sender.tenant_id AND su.id=sender.staff_user_id AND su.status='ACTIVE' WHERE sender.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND sender.corp_id=#{corpId} AND sender.room_id=#{roomId} AND sender.wecom_userid=#{wecomUserid} AND sender.participant_type='STAFF' AND sender.status='ACTIVE')
